Hello,

I was trying out the latest version of Shiny with the UI layout guide (https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/wiki/Shiny-Application-Layout-Guide), but I was having trouble getting the navbarMenu UI element to work properly. 

Here's the test code:

```r
library(shiny)
runApp(
  list(
    ui = navbarPage('testapp', 
      navbarMenu('menu',
         tabPanel('test_panel_1', pageWithSidebar(
           headerPanel('header_1'),
           sidebarPanel(),
           mainPanel()
         )),
         tabPanel('test_panel_2', pageWithSidebar(
           headerPanel('header_2'),
           sidebarPanel(),
           mainPanel()
         ))
      ),
      tabPanel('Other Panel',
      pageWithSidebar(
        headerPanel('test'),
        sidebarPanel(),
        mainPanel()
      ))),
    server = function(input, output) {}
  )
)
```

When I try to click on the 'menu' drop down button, the menu does not pop up and the text "tab-pane active" is shown in the main app area.

the first item in navbarPage can't be a navbarMenu.
